content.short: StellaSwap is a hybrid DEX on Moonbeam with a standard, stable and concentrated liquidity AMM.
content.description: StellaSwap is a hybrid DEX that combines standard, stable and concentrated liquidity AMMs to enable the most efficient price discovery for assets on Moonbeam. The platform pairs its DEX with an integrated DeFi gateway, providing streamlined access to the ecosystem via the native bridge, a swap-for-gas feature, and a range of DeFi opportunities—all reachable with a single click. This design simplifies trading and DeFi participation for users seeking fast, cost-effective swaps within Moonbeam’s active ecosystem.
